title: Per-question failure catalogue record (one line of locomo_dev_failures.jsonl / opbench_dev_failures.jsonl)
description: One wrong LoCoMo question (or one OP-Bench probe scoring below 0.5) with the pipeline stage that lost it, the sub-type, where the evidence was lost, the generic fix, the decision mechanism that would take it, the linked gap ids and the already-built feature (flag) that should address it. The committed LoCoMo file carries NO corpus text (question, gold and answer are null or absent); the full-text copy stays in the gitignored evals/runs/_analysis/. The OP-Bench file is never committed (no licence).

category.description: LoCoMo: single-hop | multi-hop | temporal | open-domain | adversarial. OP-Bench: the type label, e.g. sycophancy/fine-grained

failure_code.description: short code: b, c1, c2, d-list, d-count, d-date, d-ref, d-inf, d-detail, d-distr, e, f, c5-swap, c5-near, c5-entity, c5-answerable (LoCoMo); an OP-Bench class slug

failure_stage.description: a write path, b recall (no leg), c cut by fusion/rerank/assembly, d reader, e judge, f gold/dataset error

evidence.description: LoCoMo only: one entry per gold evidence turn

lost_at.description: recall | fusion | rerank | assembly | rescued | in_context | unknown

signals.description: OP-Bench only: cheap automated signals (persona_share, leak_n, ref_cues, best_overlap, affirm, role_inv, context_tokens)

decision_mechanism.description: which decision point decides it: heuristic rule, OpenDecider typed question via the decider port, store-calibrated gate, perspective resolver, reranker score

built_feature.description: already-built flag/arm that should address it, with the queued screen

errata_known.description: tag in locomo_errata.json (gold_error, needs_image, evidence_label_error) or null

errata_candidate.description: a new errata candidate found by this pass (reason), or null
